About

Capital Painters is a London based company who believe in delivering an outstanding service to all of our clients, starting from the initial quote, right through to the completion of the works, with customer service being of equal importance to our workmanship.

Offering a friendly and reliable service, Capital Painters carry out each and every job to the highest of standards. Whether that be a small interior bathroom in need of a freshen up, or the whole exterior of a Georgian Mansion needing a full repaint, every job is carried out with the same care and attention to detail. We will ensure that the workplace is kept tidy throughout, causing the minimum amount of disruption possible, whilst always putting the customers' needs first.

As well as being a member of Which? trusted traders we are also accredited with the government endorsed Trustmark, and are Dulux select decorator certified.
